authority.board: Army Futures Command, Futures and Concepts Center
authority.signer: Army Deputy Chief of Staff, G-8

consequencesOfErroneousOutput: The 2022 TWV Strategy sets TWV fleet capabilities and requirements for a force the Army plans to have MDO-capable in a single theater by 2028; a wrong answer buys the wrong number and type of tactical wheeled vehicles for that force. GAO-21-460 does not state the consequences of error; this sentence is a reconstruction from the study's stated purpose (printed pp. 6, 9).
decisionToBeMade: what TWV fleet capabilities and requirements the Army's 2022 TWV Strategy should adopt

definitions.text: the technologies and abilities needed to achieve a specific mission, for example, the fuel capacity, or equivalent, needed to travel 300 miles (printed p. 6)
the number and types of TWVs needed to achieve Army objectives (printed p. 6)

limitations.mitigation: Modeling officials stated they modified an existing scenario previously developed to support a European Command wargame (printed pp. 13–14); recorded as sc-europe-mdo.
limitations.statement: In the Distribution and Transportation line of effort, the Army identified the lack of a sufficient, Office of the Secretary of Defense-approved, Multi-Domain Operations Defense Planning Scenario for the European theater as a limitation (printed pp. 13–14).

limitations.mitigation: no mitigation was necessary for this limitation since there were no specific shortfalls identified at the brigade level
limitations.statement: Another limitation identified for this line of effort was a sustainment analysis focused on distribution from the theater operations down to the brigade level (printed p. 14).

question: to identify the capabilities and requirements needed for TWVs in the MDO environment (printed p. 9), to inform the Army's 2022 TWV Strategy (printed pp. 9, 12)

included: the TWVs the Army needs for a notional force in a European MDO environment (printed p. 12)
about 66 percent of the types of units currently used in the Army (printed p. 12)
some surrogate units for those that currently do not exist but may in 2028— such as Strategic Fires Battalions (printed p. 12)

successCriteria: a 2022 TWV Strategy informed by identified capabilities and requirements
